items.text: As COVID cases & hospitalization rates spike due to Omicron, we especially thank the doctors, nurses, other medical professionals, & first responders who have gone above and beyond the call of duty. Our Nation is forever grateful for their tireless efforts during the pandemic. https://t.co/FxsMQKfYIE

We must take care of those who took care of us. I was proud to stand with over 40 Veterans Service Organizations in voting for the Honoring Our PACT Act, which provides VA health care & disability benefits to Veterans that suffered toxic exposures during their deployments. https://t.co/4ea0mf8woq
Wishing everyone throughout the Sixth District Slàinte Mhath (Good Health) on this #StPatricksDay! https://t.co/GhF5uZd5mY

I enjoyed learning about @DeltaDentalofVA's involvement in the Local Impact for Tomorrow (LIFT) program during a visit to the company’s Virginia headquarters in Roanoke today. LIFT partners with Fallon Park Elementary School to provide health care services to families in need. https://t.co/2ut7GQbDqS

For people with health problems, use of marijuana derivatives may offer potential medical benefits. As a Delegate, I passed laws that support certain marijuana-based treatments, and this week I voted for further research to determine the safety of medical cannabis.

We must ensure Veterans have access to timely and quality health care. I was pleased to join my colleagues in introducing the Patient Advocate Act, which will create greater accountability at the VA by allowing Veterans to track the status of complaints they've submitted. https://t.co/PSNNQcAEFb

I’m pleased to see the @DeptVetAffairs add nine rare cancers to their “presumptive service connection” list. This is another positive step toward ensuring Veterans receive the health care benefits they’ve earned, especially for those exposed to burn pits. https://t.co/wKIH3fo5nk

The CDC blatantly skirted the law by using the Public Health Services Act as justification for the mask mandate. The interpretation of this statute was unconstitutional and egregious, and I asked AG Garland why he was appealing a federal judge’s ruling overturning the mandate. https://t.co/cmkElSFrHw

I was grateful to celebrate the life and work of retired Army Master Sergeant Silverine James at the dedication of the Salem VAMC Women’s Health Clinic in her honor. I was glad she was able to attend the monumental occasion. https://t.co/3AaTmG4zWm

I'm pleased to be introducing legislation to build on the Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics (PACT) Act with Rep. Pappas (D-NH), which would provide incentives to improve and expand medical staff within the VA Medical Systems, especially for rural areas. https://t.co/JMWpfD1frI

*For Veterans struggling with their mental health there is a new resource to help. Starting on July 16th, the Veterans Crisis Line will have a new option for phone contact. Dial 988, then Press 1 when prompted. https://t.co/zDot4KeBav

I was pleased to meet with the head of Buena Vista Family Pharmacy, Brian Morris. We’re grateful to local pharmacies like his for providing Virginia families the medicine they need. https://t.co/eTcGGdT91a
I want to wish a blessed Rosh Hashanah to all who celebrate in Virginia and across the Nation! May the new year be filled with health, happiness, and prosperity. https://t.co/z5QmTVDWPr

Proud the House passed the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act. A baby born alive after an attempted abortion should be given ALL medical care & not as Gov. Northam said “kept comfortable while the mother & physician discuss options.”

The ONLY option is to save a child.

🚨@HouseGOP just passed legislation to END the Biden admin’s one-size-fits-all COVID mandate on health care workers.

These heroes on the frontlines SAVED LIVES during the pandemic— they should not be FORCED to take the jab or lose their job.

It was great to meet with members of the Virginia Rural Health Association. We discussed the growing needs of clinics and hospitals in rural areas like VA-06, especially reducing regulations on telehealth services and capabilities. https://t.co/RMhYY8EZCj

The surge of illegal migrants at our southern border has drained resources and put an enormous financial burden on Yuma Regional Medical Center, Yuma’s only hospital.

While the Biden admin continues to distract from this crisis, @JudiciaryGOP is getting answers. https://t.co/VhiXoIBTc7

First, Democrats wanted CRT in our schools.

Now, they want schools to fearmonger about “climate change” in the name of our children’s mental health.

The Biden admin plans to provide BILLIONS of dollars worth of health care, food and even housing to the 5.7 million illegal migrants in the U.S.

This is a MASSIVE giveaway and will force American taxpayers to pick up the tab. 

Unacceptable.
It was a pleasure to tour New Horizons Healthcare in Roanoke and learn about the important work they do to provide quality medical care to folks in the Star City. https://t.co/VhWGAn99Eg

Joe Biden says that “we have the best economy in the world” and that the economic crisis “was a consequence of the crisis we had in health.” 

Americans are still SPENDING $11,400 dollars more a year on basic goods, and the Biden admin’s failed economic policies are to blame.

https://t.co/4URf7ousJi

It was a privilege to join leading industries and brands yesterday at SHOP SAFELY: Genuine Products for Fit, Function, and Safety to discuss the urgent need to protect businesses and consumers from the significant health, safety, and economic threats posed by counterfeits. I am proud to co-lead the SHOP SAFE Act, which holds online marketplaces accountable for trademark liability and incentivizes best practices like vetting third-party sellers.
To those celebrating Passover throughout the Sixth District, I wish you peace, joy, and health. Chag Sameach! https://t.co/RDPYld10Vh

Great news for Salem! QualiChem is investing $9 million to expand into a new 48,550-square-foot facility.

As a leading producer of metalworking fluids and water treatment solutions, QualiChem plays a key role in supporting critical industries like aerospace, medical, and automotive.

https://t.co/oJpv12gKwX

The ACGME abused its monopoly over medical residency accreditation to push radical DEI mandates and put politics ahead of patients.

I’m glad this misguided policy was suspended. Merit, not ideology, should guide the training of America’s doctors. https://t.co/6TkL43Wdcc
